data.name: Tupana
data.description: Tupana (Tupana RGN) is a Brazilian climate-tech startup producing biochar from agricultural waste via pyrolysis, targeting voluntary carbon market sales. The company is in a validation phase with pilot pyrolysis operations, laboratory biochar quality testing, and field MRV trials aimed at ≥100-year carbon permanence.
